name: CSO_STG_ARTICLE_VIEWS
description: Staging table to be populated from svc_req_action_capture

columns.name: ARTICLE_VIEWS_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the table. Populated by sequence number.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: QUERY_SOURCE
columns.description: The query source stores how the document was accessed.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: The unique ID for the interface. Will be used to identify an HR view from a Service view.

columns.name: ANSWER_ID
columns.description: A way to uniquely identify an article by locale ID and content ID.

columns.name: CONTENT_ID
columns.description: This is the reference to the article in the CSO_CONTENT table.

columns.name: CONTENT_VERSION_ID
columns.description: This is the reference to the article version in the CSO_CONTENT_TEXT table.

columns.name: REQUEST_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date and time of the creation of the row in the request action capture table.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: This is the document ID of the article.

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: This is the reference to the locale in CSO_LOCALE table.

columns.name: SESSION_ID
columns.description: The global session id that determines how long a user was logged in.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the reference to the user in CSO_USER_INFORMATION table.
